why: Crayon Shin-chan: Kikikaikai! Ora no Youkai Vacation, the 34th Crayon Shin-chan feature, released 2026-07-31. The four catalogue rows are one run: anilist:208829 carries a SAME_AS handle to mal:63512, offline:anilist-208829 carries one to anilist:208829 and offline:mal-63512 one to mal:63512, anilist and mal agree on the day-precise date 31 Jul 2026 and on the MOVIE type, and mal and both offline rows give episodeCount 1 (anilist carries no count). mal spells the subtitle Youkai Bake-shon where anilist translates it Youkai Vacation, which is the same subtitle romanised two ways. nf:80243204 is a different work: it is Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Unkokusai's Ambition, the 1995 third film in the series, with startDate 1995-01-01 and a sole episode of that name, so its SAME_AS handles to all four rows are wrong and it is kept apart from anilist:208829 rather than merged. The Netflix episode pairs with nothing, because the row carrying it is a different film.
